const trolleySpriteImages={idle:{down:[],up:[],left:[],right:[]},walk:{down:[],up:[],left:[],right:[]},take:{down:[],up:[],left:[],right:[]}};
let trolleySpritesReady=false;
(function(){
 let pending=0;
 for(const action of Object.keys(TROLLEY_SPRITE_DATA)){
   for(const dir of Object.keys(TROLLEY_SPRITE_DATA[action])){
     for(const src of TROLLEY_SPRITE_DATA[action][dir]){
       pending++;
       const img=new Image();
       img.onload=()=>{pending--; if(pending<=0)trolleySpritesReady=true;};
       img.onerror=()=>{pending--; if(pending<=0)trolleySpritesReady=true;};
       img.src=src;
       trolleySpriteImages[action][dir].push(img);
     }
   }
 }
 if(pending===0)trolleySpritesReady=true;
})();
function drawTrolleyCustomer(o){
 const action=(o.anim==='walk'?'walk':(o.anim==='take'?'take':'idle'));
 const frames=trolleySpriteImages[action]?.[o.dir]||trolleySpriteImages.idle.down;
 if(!frames||!frames.length)return false;
 const frameIndex=action==='walk'?(Math.floor((o.animClock||0)*(o.dir==='left'||o.dir==='right'?7:5))%frames.length):0;
 const img=frames[frameIndex]||frames[0];
 if(!img || !(img.naturalWidth||img.width))return false;
 const x=o.x*TILE, y=o.y*TILE;
 const targetH=(o.dir==='left'||o.dir==='right')?70:74;
 const scale=targetH/(img.naturalHeight||img.height||targetH);
 const w=(img.naturalWidth||img.width)*scale;
 const h=(img.naturalHeight||img.height)*scale;
 const offsets={down:[0,4],up:[0,6],left:[12,6],right:[-12,6]}[o.dir]||[0,4];
 ctx.save();
 ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 ctx.fillStyle='#0008';
 ctx.beginPath();
 if(o.dir==='left'||o.dir==='right')ctx.ellipse(x,y+12,17,5,0,0,Math.PI*2); else ctx.ellipse(x,y+12,14,5,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 ctx.fill();
 ctx.drawImage(img, Math.round(x-w/2+offsets[0]), Math.round(y-h+18+offsets[1]), Math.round(w), Math.round(h));
 ctx.restore();
 return true;
}
// Two-tile trolley: the shopper occupies the leading tile, the basket trails
// approximately one tile behind. It is kept in world space, not HUD space.
function drawShoppingCart(o){
 if(!o.cart)return;
 const dir=o.dir||'up',dx=dir==='left'?-1:dir==='right'?1:0,dy=dir==='up'?-1:dir==='down'?1:0;
 const bx=(o.x-dx*.79)*TILE,by=(o.y-dy*.79)*TILE;
 ctx.save();ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 ctx.fillStyle='#0007';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(bx,by+13,16,5,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
 ctx.translate(Math.round(bx),Math.round(by));
 if(Math.abs(dx)>0){
   ctx.fillStyle='#495968';ctx.fillRect(-17,-12,34,4);ctx.fillStyle='#9eb8c3';ctx.fillRect(-15,-24,28,15);
   ctx.fillStyle='#344e65';for(let i=-11;i<14;i+=7)ctx.fillRect(i,-22,2,12);
   ctx.fillStyle='#d5e4e9';ctx.fillRect(-15,-26,27,3);
   ctx.fillStyle='#202a39';ctx.fillRect(-12,4,7,7);ctx.fillRect(7,4,7,7);
 }else{
   ctx.fillStyle='#536777';ctx.fillRect(-15,-17,30,25);
   ctx.fillStyle='#a8c5cf';ctx.fillRect(-13,-24,26,26);
   ctx.fillStyle='#466273';for(let i=-10;i<13;i+=7)ctx.fillRect(i,-22,2,19);
   for(let i=-15;i<1;i+=8)ctx.fillRect(-12,i,25,2);
   ctx.fillStyle='#e2eff1';ctx.fillRect(-16,-27,32,4);
   ctx.fillStyle='#1e2c39';ctx.fillRect(-13,7,7,7);ctx.fillRect(6,7,7,7);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function drawCustomer(o){
if(o.cart && trolleySpritesReady && drawTrolleyCustomer(o)){
drawCandyPackage(o);
return;
}
if(o.cart)drawShoppingCart(o);
if(!customerSpritesReady||!customerSpriteImages[o.variant]?.[o.anim]?.[o.dir]?.length){
drawFigure(o,CATS[o.code].name==='Дед'?'#b5c4d3':o.hasCandy?'#91eed0':'#f3d07a',o.code,false);
return;
}
const frames=customerSpriteImages[o.variant][o.anim][o.dir];
const frameIndex=o.anim==='walk'?(Math.floor((o.animClock||0)*7)%frames.length):o.anim==='take'?(Math.floor((o.animClock||0)*4)%frames.length):0;
const img=frames[frameIndex]||frames[0];
const x=o.x*TILE,y=o.y*TILE;
const targetH=o.anim==='take'?64:58;
const scale=targetH/(img.naturalHeight||img.height||targetH);
const w=(img.naturalWidth||img.width||targetH)*scale;
const h=(img.naturalHeight||img.height||targetH)*scale;
ctx.save();
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
ctx.fillStyle='#0008';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+10,12,4.5,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.drawImage(img,x-w/2,y-h+15,w,h);
ctx.restore();
drawCandyPackage(o);
}


// Hero sprites: approved blue-vest manager. Separate walking and box-unpacking actions.
const HERO_SPRITE_DATA={"right_idle":"data:image/png;base64,","right_step1":"data:image/png;base64,","right_mid":"data:image/png;base64,","right_step2":"data:image/png;base64,","left_step1":"data:image/png;base64,","left_mid":"data:image/png;base64,","left_step2":"data:image/png;base64,
